name: Our Lord in the Attic
description: Merchant Jan Hartman bought the canal house and two rear alley houses in 1661 and joined their attics to create a hidden Catholic church, when public Catholic worship was forbidden. The surviving church is an example of Amsterdam’s tolerated private worship. The museum opened in 1888; its 2015 entrance at number 38 links to the historic house underground, leaving Heintje Hoekssteeg open.
